message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Li (defendant) transferred经营权 of arcade, bought three fishing machines (打鱼机) each with 8 slots, placed in arcade, providing gambling venue and tools. The machines have gambling function. He operated illegally for three days, illegal profit 150 yuan. He was caught, then surrendered (self-surrender). So crimes: illegal gambling (providing gambling venue and equipment). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "开设赌场罪" (operating a casino) or "提供赌博场所、赌博工具罪". The typical charge: "开设赌场罪" (establishing a casino) or "提供赌博场所、赌博工具罪". In examples, they used "重大责任事故;诈骗" etc. For gambling they used "赌博" sometimes "开设赌场". In earlier example: "聚众斗殴" for fighting. For gambling they used "赌博". Example: "经审理查明，2014年10月下旬至2015年1月7日被告人项某多次召集...进行赌博活动，并从中非法获利人民币1万余元。" Answer: "赌博". So they used simple term "赌博". So likely answer: [罪名]赌博<eoa>. Also maybe "提供赌博场所、赌博工具罪". But pattern seems to use short term. So answer: "赌博".
